instruction.text: Which mood is the following sentence in?

atoms.a: She needs to be taken to the doctor.
How could the sentence sound in the imperative mood?
b: Can we take her to the doctor?
I would be thankful if they could take her to a doctor.

instruction.text: Which mood is the following sentence in?

atoms.a: If Jeremy could, he would bake something every day.
atoms.sound: If Jeremy could. he would bake something every day.

atoms.a: How could the sentence sound in the indicative mood?
b: Jeremy wishes to bake for the rest of his life.

instruction.text: Which mood is the following sentence in?

atoms.a: Anna suggested that Matthew write a to-do list for the upcoming party.
How could the sentence sound in the interrogative mood?
b: ++Will Anna suggest that Matthew write a to-do list for the upcoming party?
Anna would be elated if Matthew wrote a to-do list for the upcoming party.

instruction.text: Match the mood with the example sentences.

atoms.a: We met each other at the cinema.
Do you remember what time we wanted to meet?

instruction.text: Match the mood with the example sentences.

atoms.a: If I could have a superpower, it would be the ability to fly.

instruction.text: Which mood is the bolded verb in?

atoms.a: He translates English to sign language for a living.
Be extremely cautious when operating any type of welding machinery.
Did your uncle make it to the meeting on time?
He would appreciate it if you listened to him more carefully.
She suggested that we check out the historic section of the town.
